{"content":""""PyMC 5.x equivalent of /app/hierarchical_model.jags.

JAGS model:
    y[i] ~ dnorm(theta[group[i]], tau)
    theta[j] ~ dnorm(mu, tau_theta)
    mu ~ dnorm(0, 0.001)          # mean 0, precision 0.001
    tau ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)    # shape 0.001, rate 0.001
    tau_theta ~ dgamma(0.001, 0.001)
    sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau)

Parameterization notes:
- JAGS `dnorm(mean, precision)` uses precision tau = 1/variance.
  PyMC `pm.Normal` accepts `tau` (precision) directly, so we pass
  `tau=` to preserve the exact parameterization.
- JAGS `dgamma(shape, rate)` maps to `pm.Gamma(alpha=shape, beta=rate)`.
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pymc as pm

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv("/app/train_data.csv")
y = df["y"].to_numpy()
# Group IDs are 1-based; map to 0-based indices for Python arrays
group_idx = df["group"].to_numpy(dtype=int) - 1
N = len(y)
K = int(df["group"].max())  # number of groups (assumes contiguous 1..K)

with pm.Model() as hierarchical_model:
    # Priors (equivalent to JAGS)
    mu = pm.Normal("mu", mu=0, tau=0.001)
    tau = pm.Gamma("tau", alpha=0.001, beta=0.001)
    tau_theta = pm.Gamma("tau_theta", alpha=0.001, beta=0.001)

    # Group-level means
    theta = pm.Normal("theta", mu=mu, tau=tau_theta, shape=K)

    # Likelihood
    y_obs = pm.Normal("y_obs", mu=theta[group_idx], tau=tau, observed=y)

    # Derived quantity (equivalent to JAGS sigma <- 1 / sqrt(tau))
    sigma = pm.Deterministic("sigma", 1 / pm.math.sqrt(tau))

    # Posterior inference
    trace = pm.sample(
        draws=2000,
        tune=1000,
        chains=2,
        cores=2,
        random_seed=42,
    )

# Posterior means
mu_est = float(trace.posterior["mu"].mean().item())
tau_est = float(trace.posterior["tau"].mean().item())
sigma_est = float(trace.posterior["sigma"].mean().item())
theta_est = trace.posterior["theta"].mean(dim=("chain", "draw")).to_numpy()

print(f"mu = {mu_est}")
print(f"tau = {tau_est}")
print(f"sigma = {sigma_est}")
print(f"theta = {theta_est}")

# Save outputs: numeric data only, no headers
np.savetxt("/app/mu_est.csv", np.atleast_1d(mu_est), delimiter=",")
np.savetxt("/app/tau_est.csv", np.atleast_1d(tau_est), delimiter=",")
np.savetxt("/app/sigma_est.csv", np.atleast_1d(sigma_est), delimiter=",")
np.savetxt("/app/theta_est.csv", np.atleast_1d(theta_est), delimiter=",")
","path":"/app/pymc_analysis.py"}
